rows.grounds: compound denoting an obstacle caused by demons; object of destruction implied by the final epithet
emphatic particle reinforcing the certainty of the statement
future predicate indicating what she will become in that context
compound epithet describing her as the destroyer of all demons

items.question: What role will she fulfill regarding obstacles caused by demons?
premises: An obstacle caused by demons is at issue.
She will indeed come to be in that situation.
She is characterized as the destroyer of all demons.
items.inference: Therefore, she will be the one who destroys the obstacle posed by demons.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between daitya+vighnaṃ and sarva+daitya+niṣūdanī is contextually inferred rather than explicitly marked.
items.plain_english: Indeed, she will be the destroyer of all demons and will remove the obstacle caused by the demons.
